description: This file defines various classes for handling HTTP authentication schemes in FastAPI, including Basic, Bearer, Digest, and general HTTP authentication base class. It includes credential models, authentication logic, and error handling.

classes.name: HTTPBasicCredentials
classes.description: Model for storing HTTP Basic authentication credentials with username and password.

classes.name: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
classes.description: Model for storing HTTP authorization scheme and credentials.

classes.name: HTTPBase
classes.description: Base class for HTTP authentication schemes, providing common logic for authentication and error handling.

classes.name: HTTPBasic
classes.description: Implementation of HTTP Basic authentication scheme.

classes.name: HTTPBearer
classes.description: Implementation of HTTP Bearer token authentication scheme.

classes.name: HTTPDigest
classes.description: Stub implementation for HTTP Digest authentication scheme, mainly for OpenAPI connection.

methods.name: make_authenticate_headers
methods.description: Creates headers for WWW-Authenticate based on the scheme.

methods.name: make_not_authenticated_error
methods.description: Generates an HTTP 401 Unauthorized exception with appropriate headers.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Asynchronous method to extract and validate authentication credentials from request headers.
